svg.title: Experience, where Sathish Lella has worked
svg.desc: An animated night scene: a dirt trail winds through a moonlit forest past four lantern-lit signposts while a small guide walks down it. 02 / EXPERIENCE. Where I have worked. From research labs to client projects, across three countries. Taylor's University, AI Research Engineer, Jul 2026 - Present | Selangor, Malaysia: Enterprise RAG on OpenSearch and Nomic embeddings; Fine-tuned Qwen, Mistral, Phi-4, DeepSeek R1; 98.4% verified identifier accuracy on 9,058 certificate layouts. AI Engineering Consultant, Independent / Freelance, May 2024 - Jun 2026 | Remote: Resume ranking for 200+ CVs a day, about 78% less manual screening time; GPT interview agent rated 4.7 / 5 by 50+ users; Recruiting CRM and automated Power BI reporting. Lewis University, Academic Graduate Assistant, Jan 2024 - May 2024 | Illinois, USA: Taught Data Analytics and Big Data programming; Graded undergraduate coursework with feedback; Research: LLMs, image and 3D segmentation. Mphasis, Associate Software Engineer, client Charles Schwab, Aug 2021 - Dec 2022 | Bangalore, India: Client accounts, API keys and access authorization; Postman validation before production release; Java backend, SQL and NoSQL, full stack when needed.
